title: Reasons to stay natural: sustainability & emotional stability
summary: NH argues natural lifting is sustainable: you own your muscle, stay big year-round without on/off cycles, and gain hormonal and emotional stability. Natural-built muscle can be maintained naturally into later life, and the effort is fully yours.
claims: Natural lifters are not dependent on any substance to keep their muscle; supplements are optional extras
Being natural means being big all the time, without the peaks and valleys enhanced lifters go through between on- and off-cycle
Enhanced lifters off-cycle often hide their bodies out of shame at how small they've become
The link between physique and mental strength and well-being is the most underrated benefit of staying natural
The natural way demands discipline, routine and a strong mind-body relationship; drugs do much of that work and remove it
Exogenous hormones make users emotionally unstable; PED users show their good days online but suffer depression and self-doubt
A body built without drugs can be kept without drugs, even into your 40s, since natural hormones don't just crash
Every training session adds a block to the pyramid; there's no need to race
Building yourself up naturally fulfills something biologically engraved in human DNA
